in_marathi.name: Dhanvika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rice or Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dhanvika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dhanvika is derived from two words: 'dhan' meaning rice or wealth, and 'vika' meaning many or various.

in_bengali.name: Dhanvika
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Rice or Wealth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dhanvika একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Dhanvika is derived from two words: 'dhan' meaning rice or wealth, and 'vika' meaning many or various.
